parent_inspection: Seal recording/replay preserves full-validation image lock statements
image_payload calls image_content; scoped current-image guard follows successful held seal
Existing single concurrent branch reads one image only

report.SUMMARY: Source review supports a narrowly scoped, preregistered candidate only after paired measurement and caller regressions. Successful held-seal replay already reacquires selected row locks; a generic mixed multi-image deadlock is not established as a new target-caller defect.
IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES: Conditional recommendation only: changing _verify_current_images from per-declaration image_content to image_contents is a bounded candidate if measured component benefit is material. Keep binding lookup/unseal, every fresh byte read and SHA256 comparison, declared ordering, transaction scope, seals/object verification and all outer authority gates. No application changes or performance acceptance are established by this review.

Caller boundary: rights_portability_export.py267–313 requires atomic and calls _verify_current_images only after holds(export,caller) succeeds, after verify_export_objects. Its one-operation validation cache is transaction/case/export-bound and is unchanged by the candidate. rights_validation_seal.py169–205 records actual full-validator SELECTs,311–315 replays those statements,344–374 requires current rule/caller/expiry and equal results. _validate_export_binding→image_payload (export.py332–405,105–181) calls image_content for every declared snapshot, verifies every package and requires complete declaration coverage. Therefore a successful held seal replays those Blob/Photo SELECT FOR UPDATE locks before _verify_current_images; this strongly limits NEW lock waits at the target caller. This is source reasoning, not a runtime lock trace.

Outer serialization: rights_scope.py110–137 locks agencies then Person then optional Listing then RightsRequest. reviewer_case uses lock_listing=True (rights_exports.py254–262); download locks case/person then export (714–729); object delivery _fresh uses same ordering (rights_object_delivery.py82–89); response prepare uses reviewer_case then export and binding locks (response_draft.py31–64). Same-person cooperating rights workflows serialize even across different cases. Distinct persons can share Blob because sha256 is global unique and Photo has Blob FK (mediafiles/models.py7–29), so same-person serialization alone is not a universal shared-blob proof.

Generic deadlock schedule is hypothetical: a multi-image single reader could hold Blob B then request A while bulk holds A and requests B. The existing test_reverse_bulk_and_single_readers_complete_with_real_pg_locks only calls image_content for ONE photo in its single branch (test_rights_image_contents_bulk.py124–151, especially136–138); it proves no general multi-single ordering guarantee. However asserting a newly introduced caller deadlock from this schedule would be unsupported: _verify_current_images first follows successful replay holding its selected locks. Existing full replay/image_payload may already use declaration/package lock order, which candidate does not change. Any broader issue requires reachable source schedules and PostgreSQL evidence, not a helper-only hypothetical.

Freshness/ownership: single helper first scopes Photo by person, then locks Blob, then unscoped Photo by PK, checks mapping/ready/derivative (rights_exports.py883–893). Bulk normalizes unique UUIDs, checks exact scoped ID set, locks Blob sorted PK then scoped Photo sorted PK, rechecks membership/mapping after waits, and yields in caller order (897–931). This is stricter post-wait ownership checking and does not cache metadata across invocations. Both call identical bounded fresh _read_image_blob (935–950); every successful declared image remains read/hash validated.

Nonidentical rejection sequencing: bulk normalizes/checks every ID and initial membership before any content read; original loop can read and reject an early digest before discovering a later invalid/missing ID. Duplicate IDs now explicitly reject, while original loop could read duplicates. Valid sealed selections are already uniqueness/shape checked (rights_portability_images.py39–86) and bound by full validation/replay, so these are malformed-input/error-order differences rather than demonstrated successful-path regressions. Do not promise identical internal exception text/order. Ensure external download remains private rejection/no delivery and failure audits roll back as before. Preserve empty declarations as no reads; avoid truncating iterator/declarations with non-strict zip.

Authority: neither image helper authorizes current reviewer/session/MFA or expiry. Bulk documentation explicitly delegates current authority/source to caller (rights_exports.py898–902). Existing generate has fresh_authority after final validation (export.py568–570); response prepare checks it and current proof after historical validation (response_draft.py177–185); binary image inspector rechecks authority/source after reading (image_read.py196–215). Download is receipt/proof/channel scoped, not reviewer login (rights_exports.py716–779). Do not add a test that assumes helpers themselves provide these gates, or remove parent gates because helper metadata is fresh. Holds checks time after replay but before physical verification; any expiry-during-file-read question is preexisting and not solved by metadata batching.

Existing recommended witnesses (not executed): tests/test_rights_image_contents_bulk.py::test_bulk_fresh_metadata_is_three_queries_and_preserves_single_bytes; ::test_bulk_rejects_mapping_changed_during_actual_blob_lock_wait; ::test_sixteen_images_four_calls_keep_sixty_four_physical_reads; ::test_physical_bytes_changed_between_children_roll_back_all_batch_audits; tests/test_rights_validation_seal.py::test_generation_seals_and_later_validations_use_it; ::test_any_input_change_disables_the_seal_and_matches_full_validation; ::test_seal_expires_at_the_earliest_loaded_expiry_and_on_code_change; ::test_access_downloads_do_not_reuse_a_portability_image_seal; ::test_held_seal_rechecks_external_object_bytes; tests/test_rights_validation_seal_pipeline.py::test_pipeline_never_bypasses_original_full_fresh_guards. Existing covered export race family (test_rights_portability_covered_export_races.py162–270) witnesses outer case wait proof/source/coverage/permission/session/channel/expiry but its default approved_coverage call is not binary=True: do not count it alone as multi-image held-seal coverage.

New targeted witnesses needed before integration: exercise actual valid held-seal target with >=2 distinct images in reverse declaration order, observe old/new metadata SQL budget while all bytes/hash/order remain equal; mutate last physical image between successful held-seal invocations and require rejection/no new delivery/audit success; unchanged-first/changed-last must still read/hash late file. Prove actual successful replay holds every target Blob/Photo before target iteration using owned PostgreSQL lock observations, with bounded timeout and current caller context. If mixed multi-single concurrency is investigated, use distinct people sharing >=2 blobs, actual full callers and a deterministic reachable wait; generic helper deadlock is diagnostic only and must not be introduced as unconditional caller acceptance failure.
TEST_RESULTS: No tests executed by this source-only task; no runtime, timing or acceptance claims.
ASSUMPTIONS: Isolated worktree remains detached at1a63762; parent owns measurement, graph integrity, notification and integration.
SQL replay preserves SELECT FOR UPDATE semantics as implemented; caller lock completeness must be independently observed before claiming runtime proof.
RISKS: N02 component/e2e performance and whole-contract completion remain parent work.
Source equivalence analysis cannot prove arbitrary unmanaged SQL/filesystem writers, physical read timing, deadlock absence or post-wait authority under every runtime schedule.
Changing only held-seal physical guard may save a small fraction of whole MOD09 latency; measure before integrating.
RECOMMENDATIONS: Wait for valid paired helper evidence; reject candidate if same-stage timing is inconclusive/regresses or integrated contribution is immaterial.
If pursued, preregister caller-only candidate and focused actual held-seal/physical drift tests; preserve original full validator, seal replay and complete file reads.
Do not expand scope into general lock-order redesign or claim new production bug without a reachable failing case.
